<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,6,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Sharon!
I found a stone I've never seen,
so I came to report it!
<TALK 5><NAME 12><CV 4,2>Good of you to come. Let me see!

Just an ordinary stone, it seems...
Huh? Just now, it...

Yes, that's right!
Its volume just...!

It seems to have absorbed the water
from my hand! Its size changes with water.

Which means, in rain...
it might even reshape the terrain.

A Growth Marble, one might call it...
Anyway, this is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
